headline: BOS @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.12 at ATL 4.66, with a projected total of 7.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: BOS moved -0.98 runs while ATL moved -0.30, changing the projected margin by -0.68 runs. The projected total fell -1.27, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Spencer Strider has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.5 ER over the last 2 starts. Batter research is strongest for Matt Olson, Drake Baldwin, Wilyer Abreu, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin, Carlos Narváez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
